tasks.name: capacitor-shell

Create a new workspace app directory `apps/native` (add `apps/*` to the `packages:` globs in pnpm-workspace.yaml) containing a Capacitor project: install `@capacitor/core`, `@capacitor/cli`, `@capacitor/ios`, `@capacitor/android` at current stable versions, and add a `capacitor.config.ts` that points the WebView `server.url` at a configurable production/staging web URL (default to the site URL used in src/lib/site.ts; make it overridable via an env-driven or documented config constant). Do NOT modify the web app's runtime behaviour or the online PartySocket path; the web deployment stays the source of truth for UI. tasks.name: lan-p2p-transport
tasks.scopedGoal: Implement Linear CAM-22 "Implement LAN WebSocket P2P transport" (Offline P2P Phase 1.1) — the TRANSPORT LAYER ONLY. Do NOT add or modify any home-screen CTA, lobby UI, or the "Play nearby" entry point; per the project priority doc those come after the Capacitor shell wraps the current surface, so keep this change purely to the transport module to avoid rework. Create `src/p2p/types.ts` (session config, transport events) and `src/p2p/lan-transport.ts` implementing: a HOST-side lightweight in-tab message relay that fans out `ServerMessage` and collects `ClientMessage` (reuse the existing wire message types from packages/game — see packages/game/src/wire-schema.ts and types.ts; do not redefine them), a GUEST-side WebSocket client connecting to `ws://{host-ip}:{port}/room/{roomId}`, a heartbeat/ping every 3-5s to detect disconnects (disconnect detection within 5s), JSON (de)serialization of ClientMessage/ServerMessage, default port 9876 (avoid PartyKit's 8787), and handling of host-tab-close so guests receive a disconnect event. Start with the simple in-tab relay (Option B). CRITICAL online-mode invariants: make NO changes to `getPartyHost()` or the PartySocket online path (src/lib/party.ts / packages/client/src/party.ts / useGameConnection), and ensure the LAN transport is inert unless explicitly activated (a `mode==='local'` guard/entry point). Add focused unit tests (vitest) covering serialization, heartbeat/disconnect detection, and host fan-out / guest receive using a mock or in-process WebSocket. Confine changes to src/p2p/** and its tests.
acceptance: src/p2p/types.ts and src/p2p/lan-transport.ts implement host relay + guest WebSocket client using the existing packages/game wire message types
Heartbeat/ping detects disconnects within 5 seconds and host-tab-close surfaces a disconnect event to guests

No changes to getPartyHost() or the PartySocket online path; transport is inert unless mode is local
Focused vitest unit tests cover serialization, heartbeat/disconnect, and fan-out/receive and pass
